4 Promotional Villas and Network Works
RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT
A residential development of 4 private promotional villas in Rouiba, executed under a complete all-trades package (TCE) including roads and utility networks (VRD).
The project scope encompasses structural execution, facade articulation, and integrated site infrastructure to establish a cohesive residential enclave.

The development was executed as a comprehensive site package, spanning reinforced-concrete structural works, internal and external finishes, MEP installations, and dedicated roads and utility networks (VRD).
Architectural massing utilizes clean contemporary volumes, balancing private residential zones with integrated vehicle and pedestrian circulation networks.
A precise residential programme where structural durability and site infrastructure are aligned from initial earthworks to final handover.

What is 4 Promotional Villas and Network Works?
The project consists of 4 private promotional villas delivered with complete all-trades works and integrated site infrastructure.
What construction works were executed on site?
The scope covered reinforced-concrete structural engineering, interior and exterior finishes, MEP installations, and dedicated roads and utility networks (VRD).
How is the site circulation structured?
The master plan integrates dedicated vehicle and pedestrian access routes to ensure clear circulation and privacy between the 4 residential units.
